units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905
author: Black Sheep
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a scored race-and-fight round. 27 and 24 team spawns, 37 game_score entities awarding points per level end and per fail (lvl_1_end_trig, lvl_2_fail_trig, ...), two jails with timers, 21 func_breakables, placed weapons (deagle, m249, grenades) and two game_player_equip. Its levels are scored against each other rather than timed from a line, and the winner's room is a kill box. gb-maps-2. Not published.
